kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجتاز (form VIII)
# أَجْتَازُ (ʔajtāzu) /ʔad͡ʒ.taː.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
# أُجْتَازُ (ʔujtāzu) /ʔud͡ʒ.taː.zu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
# أَجْتَازَ (ʔajtāza) /ʔad͡ʒ.taː.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
# أُجْتَازَ (ʔujtāza) /ʔud͡ʒ.taː.za/: first-person si
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
